## v0.5.6 · Built-in Workspace Storage and Memory Reliability

v0.5.6 adds centralized workspace isolation directly to Core/Host and ships the memory reliability fixes merged since v0.5.5.

### Changes

- Select Centralized workspaces in Settings → Memory system. Runtime, Documents, Memory Spaces and state share an isolated directory derived from the canonical workspace path. Customize the central root, optionally retain global USER.md, and use the same routing in Sidebar, Builtin and Headless.
- Apply Runtime capacity archival consistently across tools, Actions, child Agents and browser management. Preserve distinct but similar Native facts, validate import receipts and decode subprocess UTF-8 correctly.
- Protect existing Documents during idle review and remove forget from autonomous write workers. Explicit user operations retain their tools; unsuccessful forget receipts do not claim deletion.
- List Runtime and Documents newest first by creation time. Preserve creation dates after editing and keep long workspace paths and controls usable.
- Fix npm CLI launchers under Electron while preserving native binaries and embedding overrides.

Implementation: [#216](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/pull/216), [#212](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/pull/212), [#213](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/pull/213), [#214](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/pull/214), [#199](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/pull/199).

### Packages and upgrade

The Starter advances to **0.5.6**. Runtime, Documents, Memory Spaces, Mnemon Native Provider and Default Three-tier Strategy advance to **0.5.5**; the other eleven official plugins remain at **0.5.4**.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-mnemon@0.5.6
```

Restart DSH and reload the browser. Use `headless` for that Profile. Existing storage formats remain compatible. Scope switches preserve old roots without migrating data; renamed or moved workspaces get new path-derived identities. Before downgrading to v0.5.5, switch away from `workspaces` to a supported scope and retain a backup. A Pack contains only its selected root.

The release workflow verifies the versioned workspace and independent packages, freezes the six changed artifacts, reads back and installs the full npm combination, and tests a Registry upgrade from v0.4.7 before creating this release.

### 中文说明

本版将集中式工作区隔离内置于 Core/Host，配置位于设置 → 记忆系统，可自定义集中根目录并独立保留全局 USER.md。Sidebar、Builtin 与 Headless 使用一致的工作区路由，切换范围保留旧数据，移动或重命名工作区不会自动迁移。

同时修复 Runtime 容量归档、Native 相似事实保留、UTF-8 输出、自动写入保护、创建时间排序和 Electron CLI 启动。主包发布 0.5.6，五个相关子包发布 0.5.5，其余十一个子包保持 0.5.4。回滚到 v0.5.5 前需先退出新 `workspaces` 范围并备份数据。

See the [English release notes](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/blob/v0.5.6/docs/en/releases/v0.5.6.md), [中文发布说明](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/blob/v0.5.6/docs/zh-CN/releases/v0.5.6.md) and [nine-screenshot Core WebUI report](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/blob/v0.5.6/docs/pr-assets/issue-189-core-workspaces/README.md). Historical Flash experiments retain their recorded limits and unresolved quality findings; ordinary CI does not rerun live-model or Windows-only checks.
